description: National Physical Planning Department Town and Country Planning Ordinance (Chapter 269) Declare that the Land called Purana Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya called as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Anura Karunathilake, Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities (exercising powers under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance to declare an urban development area and direct the preparation of a physical plan). This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
